name: Naqex Cloud Dead-Man's-Switch
description: Zero-dependency 24/7 Heroku monitor for a Windows 10 home PC running MT5. Alerts Telegram/Discord if PC loses power/internet >3m or MT5 triggers orphan/kill-switch (OrderSend=0).

NAQEX_INGEST_TOKEN.description: Secret Bearer token shared with pc_heartbeat_sender.py on your Windows 10 PC

NAQEX_VIEW_TOKEN.description: Optional token to protect the mobile status page (leave blank to allow link-only view)

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Telegram Bot token from @BotFather (optional if using ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL)

TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.description: Your Telegram numeric chat ID (optional if using ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL)

STALE_AFTER_SEC.description: Seconds without heartbeat before firing PC_OFFLINE alert (default 180 = 3 min)
